review_evidence: README identifies ProofWidgets as a library of Lean user-interface components for visualizations, tactic interfaces, goal displays, expression entry, and proof editing.

Complete scan of 46 Lean files found component/RPC/HTML/SVG/presentation infrastructure; all 19 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations occur under ProofWidgets/Demos rather than the core component library.
